subject: Thanksgiving week: fewer dials, better ones
previewText: Where to spend your dials this week, and how to set up December before you log off.

featuredArticle.title: Aged Leads Aren't Leads. They're a Customer Database. Here's How to Let AI Work It.
featuredArticle.spotlight: Aged leads stop disappointing you once you stop expecting them to behave like fresh ones. Treat them as a database of past inquiries, let an AI assistant tied to a Google Sheet and your Gmail write each person a personal email, and call only the people who write back. It's a workable system for a holiday week, because the emails go out while you're away from your desk.

quickTips: Cap your dials and spend them on people who already moved
